methodologyNotes: Prices fetched from official vendor pricing pages via WebFetch on 2026-06-14 where accessible. OpenAI's chatgpt.com/pricing returned HTTP 403; ChatGPT Plus ($20/mo) and Pro ($200/mo) prices corroborated from Wikipedia (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ChatGPT) and cross-referenced against multiple news reports (TechCrunch, Gizmodo, CNBC). ChatGPT Team pricing ($25/seat monthly, $20/seat annual billed annually) is widely reported but official page was not accessible; recorded as per reporting. Claude pricing fetched directly from claude.com/pricing (301 redirect from anthropic.com/pricing). Google AI plan pricing could not be fetched from one.google.com (geolocated to EUR) or gemini.google.com (requires sign-in); USD prices sourced from 9to5Google tag page (June 2026 coverage, post-I/O 2026 pricing). Perplexity pricing page returned HTTP 403; Pro ($20/mo) and Max ($200/mo) prices sourced from TechCrunch article dated 2025-07-02. Microsoft Copilot Pro ($20/user/month) sourced from Wikipedia (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Microsoft_Copilot); M365 Copilot Business ($18/user/month annual) fetched from microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365-copilot/pricing. Mistral Vibe (formerly Le Chat) pricing fetched directly from mistral.ai/pricing. All telephony fields (minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall) are null on every plan — non-telephony vertical.
